recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. issue_request: FHIR-20351 asked to remove EpisodeOfCare from DocumentReference.context.encounter and ensure the standard episode-of-care extension could still be used on DocumentReference. Jira status is Published with Persuasive resolution, applied for R5.
initial_application: Commit 24ebc2aadefd4ba91d3d5380d091e15c61a202e2 explicitly listed GF#20351 and changed the then-authoritative DocumentReference spreadsheet from Reference(Encounter|EpisodeOfCare) to Reference(Encounter) for context.encounter.
additional_context: FHIR-15658 had earlier added EpisodeOfCare to DocumentReference.context.encounter. FHIR-29801 was a later Published/Persuasive with Modification R5 issue that directed adding Appointment and EpisodeOfCare to .encounter and renaming .encounter to .context; commit d41daf2563b8d8afcba4dfbd11b877607215cd74 implemented that change. FHIR-54170 later clarified the context description because the current element allows Appointment, Encounter, and EpisodeOfCare. The workflow-episodeOfCare extension is maintained in the FHIR Extension Pack and declares DocumentReference as an allowed context.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active current source lists DocumentReference in source/fhir.ini and defines DocumentReference.context with Appointment, Encounter, and EpisodeOfCare targets. Removing EpisodeOfCare now would undo FHIR-29801 and conflict with later clarification, so the correct reconciliation for FHIR-20351 is an audit of the historical removal and later superseding re-addition.
